'''Reyzek''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], she was present at a party on Kaas City, the same party that [[Darth Zash|Lord Zash]] went to cover up her trace of planning [[Darth Skotia]]'s assassination which her [[Darth Nox|apprentice]] eventually executed.
